rust_summary: a final foreground GUI overlay (`native_gui_render_post`) and the current frame's camera during GUI rendering.
doc_summary: `native_gui_render_post(batch, gui_hidden, focused)` draws after the complete normal GUI batch: screens, prompts, toasts, debug overlays, pad cursor and IME included. It fires during gameplay, menus and the title, even with F1; loading/file-upgrade and resource-reload overlays do not fire it. The read-only host's `camera()` is the current frame's world camera (None on the panorama), including bob/spin, FOV and projection. `batch` uses GUI pixels; `gui_hidden` reports F1 and `focused` reports window focus so the mod can choose when its indicator is visible. The existing `hud` and `screen_render_post` hooks retain their drawing order and visibility rules. Bundles need "hooks": @API:gui_render_post@.
